programme.desc: 1994: Liverpool v Manchester United A chance to relive a Premier League classic. Here, arch rivals, Liverpool and Manchester United, meet at Anfield back in 1994 in a match that saw one of the Premier League's great comebacks.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2016: Swansea City v Crystal Palace A chance to relive a classic Premier League match. Here, Swansea City take on Crystal Palace at the Liberty Stadium in a high-scoring encounter during the 2016-17 season.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2001: Charlton Athletic v West Ham United Relive one of the Premier League's great games. Here, Charlton Athletic take on West Ham United at The Valley in November 2001 in a pulsating encounter that went down to the wire.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2002: Manchester City v Manchester United Manchester City took on Manchester United back in 2002 in the last Manchester derby to be played at Maine Road.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2014/15 Enjoy some of the best Premier League goals from years gone by. Here, the best strikes from the 2014-15 season, a year in which Chelsea ran away with the title.
programme.title: The Best Premier League Goals

programme.desc: Manchester City v Liverpool Take a look back at some of the best Premier League goals from top flight clashes between Manchester City and Liverpool.
programme.title: Best Premier League Goals

programme.desc: Best PL Goals: Chelsea V Arsenal Enjoy some of the finest goals from matches between London rivals Chelsea and Arsenal.
programme.title: Premier League Archive

programme.desc: 2006: Watford v Fulham Watford meet Fulham at Vicarage Road in October 2006 in a remarkable match that had a dramatic late finish.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2001: Liverpool v Chelsea Liverpool play host to Chelsea at Anfield in the 2000-2001 season, with both sides battling for places in Europe near the season's end.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2011: Wigan Athletic v West Ham United Wigan Athletic meet West Ham United at the DW Stadium in May 2011 in a crucial clash in the battle against relegation.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2011: West Ham United v Manchester United Relive a classic Premier League encounter. Here, West Ham United take on Manchester United at Upton Park in the 2010-11 season in a six-goal thriller that saw Wayne Rooney bag a hat-trick.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: A look back at the weekend's action in the Premier League, featuring all of the goals, news and major talking points from around the top flight.
programme.title: Premier League Review

programme.desc: A look back at the weekend's action in the Premier League, featuring all of the goals, news and major talking points from around the top flight.
programme.title: Premier League Review

programme.desc: Bournemouth v Fulham Sixth in the table and five unbeaten, Andoni Iraola's in-form Bournemouth welcome Marco Silva and Fulham to the Vitality Stadium for a Premier League clash on Friday Night Football.
programme.title: Friday Night Football

programme.desc: E283 — Arsenal v West Ham United Following a dramatic St James' Park win, Arsenal return to the Emirates for the visit of Nuno Espírito Santo's West Ham - who began life under the Portuguese with a draw at Everton.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E282 — Manchester United v Sunderland On a pivotal afternoon at Old Trafford, can an under-pressure Ruben Amorim get his Manchester United side firing against impressive Premier League new boys Sunderland?
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: Chelsea v Liverpool The out-of-sorts Premier League champions come next for Chelsea as Liverpool - beaten by Palace and Galatasaray just days apart - visit Stamford Bridge on Saturday Night Football.
programme.title: Saturday Night Football

programme.desc: E287 — Wolverhampton Wanderers v Brighton & Hove Albion Forced to settle for a point last weekend at Spurs, Wolves' search for a first Premier League win of the campaign continues on Super Sunday against Fabian Hurzeler's Brighton.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E285 — Aston Villa v Burnley Hit for five at City, Burnley face another tough Premier League assignment as Scott Parker's side go to Unai Emery's Villa - finally up and running with last weekend's win.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E288 — Everton v Crystal Palace Oliver Glasner's emphatic Eagles - the only unbeaten Premier League team left this season - arrive at the Hill Dickinson Stadium as David Moyes' Everton entertain Crystal Palace.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E286 — Newcastle United v Nottingham Forest A shaky start for Ange Postecoglou sees the Australian still searching for his first Premier League win with Forest, who go to St James' Park on Super Sunday to face Newcastle.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E289 — Brentford v Manchester City Super Sunday comes from the Gtech Community Stadium as Brentford - unbeaten on home soil - host Manchester City in the Premier League. City's neighbours United fell here last week.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E304 — Brighton & Hove Albion v Newcastle United Newcastle go to the South Coast for a Premier League meeting with Brighton. The Magpies pick up from a 2-0 win over Forest, while the Seagulls come from a draw with Wolves.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E306 — Crystal Palace v Bournemouth Finally succumbing to defeat, will Crystal Palace bounce back at home against the hugely impressive Bournemouth, who began the Premier League weekend sat in the top four?
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E303 — Burnley v Leeds United Seven games into the Premier League campaign, promoted sides Burnley and Leeds collide. It's Daniel Farke's Leeds who have enjoyed the stronger start with eight points on the board.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E305 — Manchester City v Everton Putting an end to Palace's unbeaten run, Everton go to Manchester City next. Despite a useful three points at Brentford, City lost influential midfielder Rodri to injury.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E307 — Sunderland v Wolverhampton Wanderers Denied a first win of the season in the dying embers against Brighton, improved Wolves go in search of three Premier League points at the Stadium of Light against Sunderland.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: Fulham v Arsenal On Saturday Night Football, Premier League pacesetters Arsenal head west to face Fulham at Craven Cottage. The Cottagers took two points off the Gunners in this fixture last year.
programme.title: Saturday Night Football

programme.desc: E308 — Tottenham Hotspur v Aston Villa Super Sunday comes from the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium as Thomas Frank's Spurs host Unai Emery's Villa in the Premier League. Both teams come from 2–1 wins over promoted opposition.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: E309 — Liverpool v Manchester United It's arch rivals Manchester United at Anfield for the Premier League champions Liverpool on Super Sunday. Arne Slot's Reds are looking to end a run of three successive defeats.
programme.title: Premier League

programme.desc: West Ham United v Brentford Rivals from the capital West Ham and Brentford meet in the Premier League on Monday Night Football. Nuno Espírito Santo is without a win in his first two games as Irons boss.
programme.title: Monday Night Football

programme.desc: S6 E1 — Lee Bowyer We sit down with Lee Bowyer to look back on the career of one of the Premier League's fiercest and most competitive midfielders. From his rise at Charlton to becoming a key figure in the brilliant Leeds United side that challenged Europe's elite and reached the Champions League semi-finals, Bowyer reflects on the highs, controversies and defining moments of his career, including spells with West Ham, Newcastle and Birmingham.
programme.title: Premier League Stories
